chapters.title: Faith, trust, and confidence
chapters.about: Internal versus external trust and seeing good intentions

chapters.title: Connecting to the Misva
chapters.about: Elevating daily actions to a spiritual level

summary: Mrs. Tawil discusses the importance of building a cohesive family unit, or 'habora', as a way to prepare for Pesah and bring Hashem's blessing into the home. She explains that by focusing on internal intentions rather than external actions and staying within one's own 'square' of responsibility, one can avoid feelings of burden and resentment. She illustrates this approach with personal stories about her family and the power of trust and faith in others.
questions: How can I stop feeling like I am the only one doing all the work for the holidays?
What does it mean to stay in my own 'square' when preparing for a family event?
How can I shift my focus from judging others' actions to seeing their good intentions?
How does building a 'habora' help bring Hashem's blessing into my home?
How can I let go of the need for perfection when working with others?
